edits.new:
Then the decision record, the logs and the published events carry no person name, contact value, address or identity number

  Scenario: AC18 Error answers 401 and 404 of the provided operations (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a caller presents no valid credential to a provided operation of this service
    When the caller calls the operation
    Then the answer is 401
    And a caller names a record that does not exist
    When the caller calls a provided operation for that record
    Then the answer is 404

  Scenario: AC19 Replay of a write with the same idempotency key (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a write of this service has been applied with an idempotency key
    When the same write arrives again with the same idempotency key
    Then the second write is not applied again
    And the answer repeats the answer of the first write

  Scenario: AC20 Duplicate delivery of a consumed event (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a consumed event has been processed for the case
    When the same event is delivered again
    Then the second delivery is ignored and counted
    And the event has one effect on the case

  Scenario: AC21 Activity retry and timeout (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given an activity of the deviation workflow is retried
    When the retried activity runs
    Then no second transfer request leaves the service for the same trigger
    Given an activity of the deviation workflow times out
    When the timeout is handled
    Then the case keeps its queue and owner until a transfer is accepted

  Scenario: AC22 A consumed call fails or does not answer (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a consumed call to rwb-case or rwb-decision fails or does not answer
    When the call fails
    Then no transfer is recorded as done and the case keeps its queue and owner
    And the trigger stays in the outbox
